goal: A prospectively fixed, bounded 32/32 sustained panel in which every workflow cell is a paid automatically selected native movement inside a generated-content continuation and has a matched withheld-result causal control.

scope.split: This declaration and exact row mapping are committed before implementation. Executable source is then frozen before one evaluation and an independent raw verification. Source-changing and failed attempts remain uncredited and preserved.
scope.compatibility: The new agenda-population schema and command namespaces are opt-in. WorkflowAgenda v1, Population v2/v3, selectors, recipes, prices, inherited meanings and all prior checkpoint bytes remain unchanged.

contract.scheduling: The scheduler chooses only a runnable paid turn. It inspects pending action ownership, actor order, locks, finite wallets and continuation state, never a desired route, recipe, truth, skill or result. Each agenda has a distinct deterministic command namespace. A peer reply, vote, disclosure or read is charged to its actual payer. Blocked work cannot borrow another actor's turn or wallet.
contract.continuation: Every row has one automatic target selection and one later automatic consumer selection. The consumer receives the exact generated target result only after any required public disclosure and paid read or own-event delivery and read. Supplied needs, initial content, stances, group membership, equipment and observations are labeled authored opportunities; no content is authored after execution starts.
contract.controls: Each row has a matched withheld-result control with the same producer opportunity, target movement and producer charges. The control withholds only the generated-result handoff before the consumer, so no consumer result or terminal usable consequence may be credited. Public-result cases additionally compare hidden-before-disclosure with delivered-after-paid-read state; hidden content cannot affect selection.
contract.semantics: A credited target must have a decoded semantic delta from its input or a generated material/event consequence, plus a downstream automatic consumer and fixed paid terminal query or use. Identity changes, labels, duplicate endpoints and scripted isolated movement do not count. Legitimate semantic convergence is reported, never silently credited as a delta.
contract.restore: Engine, agenda namespaces, actor/agenda cursors, pending actions, results, events, locks and repetition state are serialized. Interrupted and uninterrupted final checkpoint bytes must agree exactly.
contract.audit: The independent auditor imports no scheduler, selector, executor or fixture builder. From sealed raw transactions and saved state it reconstructs runnable owners, fair order, command namespaces, lock boundaries, actual charges, automatic candidate choice, exact result handoffs, decoded deltas, hidden/delivered boundaries and causal controls. Tampered ownership, charge, route, handoff, visibility or coverage summaries must fail.

settings.diagnostic_repeat_stop_disabled: separate, explicitly labeled raw case only

acceptance: Exactly 32 distinct credited target cells, both faces of all 16 names, reconstructed from frozen raw evidence; no isolated matrix case substitutes for a row
All 32 target movements and all available consumers are paid native successes selected automatically from supplied route-neutral needs; expected labels are evaluator assertions only
Every row records exact generated-result identity, decoded before/after semantics or material/event consequence, later automatic consumer and fixed paid terminal consequence
Every row has a matched withheld-result control with equal producer movement and producer cost but no credited downstream consequence
Both IEE and SLI owner-type rows succeed, and a shared-engine fairness case charges actual owners for own and peer reply/vote/read work
Public generated content has a raw hidden-before-disclosure and delivered-after-paid-read comparison; no hidden content affects an earlier choice
Finite budgets, locks, repetition stops, pending turn bound, exhausted and failed work, first intermediates and charges remain in raw evidence
Interrupted restore is byte-identical to uninterrupted execution
Independent audit rejects tampered ownership, charge, result handoff, visibility and coverage
All previously accepted exact method IDs remain present and passing; inherited source hashes remain unchanged; executable source freeze remains unchanged through evaluation
limits: This finite supplied panel demonstrates bounded engineered continuation, not spontaneous agency, truth, people typing, unbounded learning or population growth
A target counts once even if repeated; duplicates and semantic convergence are reported
No longitudinal Shell gate is claimed until FB5.6
No Phase 7 work or inherited meaning change without explicit R5
